# quickwit_source_kafka (Resource)

A Kafka source: Quickwit consumes a topic, with exactly-once semantics through its own checkpoints.

Quickwit checks that it can reach the source when it is created or updated. Sources are deleted together with their index: when the index is replaced, add `lifecycle { replace_triggered_by = [quickwit_index.<name>] }` so the source is recreated in the same apply.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "quickwit_source_kafka" "this" {
  index_id      = quickwit_index.logs.index_id
  source_id     = "kafka-source"
  topic         = "logs"
  num_pipelines = 2

  client_params = {
    "bootstrap.servers" = "kafka-1:9092,kafka-2:9092"
    "security.protocol" = "SASL_SSL"
    "sasl.mechanism"    = "PLAIN"
    "sasl.username"     = "quickwit"
    "sasl.password"     = var.kafka_password
  }

  transform = {
    script = ".message = downcase(string!(.message))"
  }

  # The source is deleted with its index: recreate it when the index is replaced.
  lifecycle {
    replace_triggered_by = [quickwit_index.logs]
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `index_id` (String) Index the source feeds. Changing it recreates the source.
- `source_id` (String) Source identifier, unique within the index. Changing it recreates the source.
- `topic` (String) Topic to consume. Changing it recreates the source.

### Optional

- `client_log_level` (String) librdkafka log level: `debug`, `info`, `warn` or `error`.
- `client_params` (Map of String, Sensitive) [librdkafka configuration](https://github.com/confluentinc/librdkafka/blob/master/CONFIGURATION.md) (`bootstrap.servers`, `security.protocol`, `sasl.password`…). Sensitive.
- `enable_backfill_mode` (Boolean) Backfill mode: index the existing messages, then stop (the source is finished once it reaches the end). Defaults to `false`.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the source is indexed. Defaults to `true`.
- `input_format` (String) Format of the messages: `json`, `plain_text`, `otlp_logs_json`, `otlp_logs_protobuf`, `otlp_traces_json`, `otlp_traces_protobuf`. Defaults to `json`.
- `num_pipelines` (Number) Number of indexing pipelines. Defaults to `1`.
- `transform` (Attributes) [VRL](https://vector.dev/docs/reference/vrl/) transform applied to each document before indexing. Not supported with OTLP input formats. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--transform))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) `<index_id>:<source_id>`.

<a id="nestedatt--transform"></a>
### Nested Schema for `transform`

Required:

- `script` (String) VRL program, e.g. `.message = downcase(string!(.message))`.

Optional:

- `timezone` (String) TZ database timezone used by VRL time functions. Defaults to `UTC`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import with <index_id>:<source_id>.
terraform import quickwit_source_kafka.this logs:kafka-source
```
